subject: Air-gapped deployment — data flow & logging qualification
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Collins <j.collins@acelab.com>, security@acelab.com
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: air-gapped deployment — initial data flow & logging clarifications

Hi Jasmine / ACELab security team,

Thanks for a productive call today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared expectations. I took notes on the items that will affect the Private (VPC / on-prem) deployment: 

• PII scope: you confirmed PII will include full name, email, phone number, device identifiers (device_id / MAC). No payment card data (PCI) will be sent to Redwood but will be handled by your tokenization proxy.
• Retention: ACELab target is 24 months for application data and 24 months for audit logs, with the ability to export on request.
• Network / egress: core requirement is no outbound internet egress from the air-gapped stack. All model calls must route to a restricted outbound proxy inside ACELab network or to a customer-controlled NAT that we can whitelist.
• Key management: customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) required for encryption-at-rest and for any long-term log archives.
• Logging & controls: need immutable audit logging with off-host export capability; retention policy enforced by ACELab but Redwood must provide filtered log exports (audit trail of API calls, user ids, IPs).

Action items / owners (initial):
- Dev (dev.patel): draft an initial VPC topology highlighting egress points and proxy integration by EOD 2027-06-19. Attachment: network-diagram-draft.v1.pdf (stub).
- Rishi (rishi.malhotra): compile SOC2 snapshot + example evidence we can share by 2027-06-25.
- Alex (me): coordinate follow-up call to walk the ACELab security team through the diagram + required firewall rules.

Please confirm I captured the constraints correctly and add anything I missed. We also noted ACELab will share a data-classification CSV with canonical PII definitions — please send that when convenient (I see security@ has the doc).

Attaching: redwood-private-deployment-checklist.pdf (application/pdf) and a draft topology (network-diagram-draft.v1.pdf).

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Collins <j.collins@acelab.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acelab.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: air-gapped deployment — initial data flow & logging clarifications

Thanks Alex — this matches the call notes closely. A couple clarifications: 

> On Fri, 18 Jun 2027 at 15:20, Alex Martinez wrote:
> > • Retention: ACELab target is 24 months for application data and 24 months for audit logs

We actually need 24 months for application data, but audit logs need a *rolling 36 months* (we have internal compliance that requires longer audit trails for certain user groups). Can Redwood support 36 months for logs, with filtered exports to our long-term archive?

Also, PII includes device serial numbers in addition to device_id fields. We do not allow any outbound traffic to third-party endpoints unless explicitly listed — this will include model endpoints or telemetry. If Redwood can support a whitelist-only egress model (we provide proxies), that would satisfy the constraint.

We attached the data classification CSV.

Attachments: acelab-data-classification.csv (text/csv)

Best,
Jasmine Collins
Head of Security & Privacy, ACELab
j.collins@acelab.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 18:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: air-gapped deployment — initial data flow & logging clarifications

Slack-style quick plan — copying Jasmine so ACELab sees commitments from our side. Quoting the key points from Jasmine: 36 months for audit logs, whitelist-only egress (customer proxies), device serial numbers included in PII.

Proposed delivery plan: 
- 2027-06-19 EOD: Dev delivers refined network diagram (VPC subnets, customer proxy / NAT points, ACLs) — owner: Dev.
- 2027-06-21: Security design note describing how we support 36-month audit retention and export hooks (S3 export / customer-owned archive) — owner: Rishi.
- 2027-06-25: Deliver SOC2 snapshot + example evidence (control IDs and sample artefacts) — owner: Rishi.
- 2027-06-20 09:00 PT: 30-minute follow-up walk-through with ACELab security to validate the diagram and firewall rules — owner: Alex to schedule.

Dev: please include the following in the diagram: explicit egress control points, private endpoints used by Redwood services, and the optional on-prem transfer process for completely air-gapped customers. If there are any blockers for a whitelist-only mode, call them out immediately.

I attached a very small draft diagram to annotate (network-diagram-draft.v1.pdf). Also adding a Drive link for collaboration.

Links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-network-diagram

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
VP, Solutions
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Recap: air-gapped deployment — initial data flow & logging clarifications

Jasmine — thanks for the quick clarifications. Confirming next steps and attachments:

• Dev will circulate the refined network diagram by EOD today (attaching network-diagram.pdf).
• Rishi will share a short design note on audit retention + export mechanics and a SOC2 snapshot by 2027-06-25.
• We can operate in whitelist-only egress mode — Redwood supports routing through a customer-controlled proxy or private NAT; we will list all external endpoints and IPs as part of the diagram.
• For air-gapped on-prem installs we will provide a checklist for on-site transfer (signed transfer manifest, offline key exchange guidance).

Proposed follow-up call: 2027-06-20 09:00 PT — please confirm or suggest an alternate.

Attaching: network-diagram.pdf (application/pdf), redwood-sample-soc2-evidence.zip (application/zip).

Look forward to the next step.

Best,
